Resolve declared traits-entry field values against the data

Source: R/utils.R
util_resolve_trait_field_values.Rd

A field set on the traits entries of metadata.yml for a context's var_in (e.g. leaf_temp: LfT_Rdark, scoping that context to just the traits declaring it) is read the way process_parse_data() reads every such field: a declared value naming a column of data.csv (after custom_R_code has run) stands for that column's contents, read per record, and anything else is the literal value itself (e.g. method_context: 250 mm branch). process_format_contexts() and dataset_test()'s context-consistency check both need this same resolution, so it lives here rather than being duplicated and drifting between the two (#276).

util_resolve_trait_field_values(declared, data)

Arguments

declared

Character vector of values declared on the traits entries for one field (already unique and stripped of NA)

data

Data frame to check declared values against – data.csv with custom_R_code applied

Value

Character vector of resolved values, without NA

Details

A blank cell in such a column is a record with no value for the context, not a context value, so NA is dropped – as it is for a var_in naming a column directly. Otherwise dataset_test() reported NA as a context value missing from the metadata whenever the column had a gap.
